# Mapa — your guide to events in Warsaw

> A map of events and activities in Warsaw. Find concerts, exhibitions, parties, theatre performances and other things to do across the city.

## Key pages

- Home: https://my-mapa.by/
- Search events: https://my-mapa.by/?tab=search
- Friends activity: https://my-mapa.by/?tab=friends

## Core features

- **Event map**: an interactive map with event markers organised by category
- **Search & filters**: search by title, category and date
- **Friends**: add friends and view their activity — what they are attending or planning to attend
- **Favorites**: save events for later
- **Google OAuth**: sign in and register with Google
- **Social sharing**: share events via Telegram, WhatsApp, VK and Viber

## Public API endpoints

- `GET /events` — filtered list of events
- `GET /events/map` — events for display on the map
- `GET /events/search` — ranked event search
- `GET /events/interesting` — curated interesting events

## Tech stack

- React 19 + TypeScript
- Vite 7
- Mapbox GL JS — mapping
- Tailwind CSS — styling
- Framer Motion — animations

## Related links

- Source code: https://github.com/anomalyco/Mapa-Frontend
